american_ephemeris_2000_2050_empirical_v.description: Empirical short-range lunar calibration for matching JPL/American Ephemeris-style geocentric tropical Moon longitude over 2000-2050. Uses initial geocentric tangential velocity correction plus empirical geocentric tangential acceleration.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_empirical_v.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar along-track acceleration. Do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.

american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_e.description: Full-book 2000-01-01 to 2050-12-31 peak-optimized empirical lunar calibration.
american_ephemeris_2000_2050_full_book_e.model_notes: Newtonian N-body + Sun 1PN GR + Earth J2 + empirical lunar along-track acceleration. Do not use this calibration for long-term stability studies.
